# AI original capacity

## Moving from "AI assistant" to "AI employee" earlier

|  |
| --- |
| Kuailu has now developed two relatively clear directions for Agent products. |
| **Aine experts** more similar to standardized digital staff, such as in-depth analysis, finance, contracts, compliance, correspondence, human resources specialists; emphasis on fixed business processes, predictable results and auditability. |
| ** Kuailu Claw** is more like the company's own generic Agent, which can learn business processes, form Skills and re-use them on a continuous basis, with cross-system operations. |
| This actually creates a valuable "two-product model": |

| Experts in the AI field | Kuailu Claw |
|---|---|
| A mature employee. | Staff development |
| Standard capacity | Custom Capabilities |
| Open the box. | Continuous learning |
| High certainty | More flexibility |
| Best practices in industry | Enterprise personalization process |

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Standard Skills asset+ enterprise custom Skills asset. | The Skills, Rules and Process Templates, which are accumulated by businesses on an ongoing basis, can create reusable organizational capacity assets. |
